name: young
text: Creatures with the young template are immature specimens of the base creature.
quick_rules: +2 to all Dex-based rolls, -2 to all other rolls, -2 hp/HD.

grows.rule: Bestiary 1 p. 295: not 'creatures that increase in power through aging or feeding (such as dragons or barghests)'. A true dragon is printed by its age category ('Adult Red Dragon'); a feeder says it gains growth points (the barghest, the nabasu). A wyvern or a pseudodragon is of the dragon type and does neither, and until 2026-10-30 the type alone refused all 126 dragon-type blocks, 36 of them ageless.

refuse.why: This template cannot be applied to creatures that increase in power through aging or feeding (such as dragons or barghests) or creatures that are Fine-sized.

describe: A young {base}, not yet grown into its strength.
